atlas.setting.minimap.tooltip: The small map in a corner of the screen. The Toggle minimap key (N) flips this too.
atlas.setting.minimap_size.tooltip: The minimap's side in GUI pixels.
atlas.setting.minimap_zoom.tooltip: How close the minimap looks. At 1x one GUI pixel is one block.
atlas.setting.coords.tooltip: Your X Y Z under the minimap.
atlas.setting.beams.tooltip: Draw a coloured beam in the world at each waypoint. Off: no beams.
atlas.setting.labels.tooltip: Show each waypoint's name and distance where it is on the screen. Off: no labels in the world.
atlas.setting.death.tooltip: Mark where you last died with a "Death" waypoint (it replaces the previous one).
atlas.setting.hover_names.tooltip: Show a waypoint's name on the world map only under the cursor, and its label in the world only when you look towards it.
atlas.setting.minimap_corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in.
atlas.setting.minimap_round.tooltip: A round minimap instead of a square one.
atlas.setting.minimap_rotate.tooltip: The way you look is up on the minimap. Off: north is up.
atlas.setting.other_coords.tooltip: A second line under the minimap: where you would be in the Nether (in the Overworld: X and Z divided by 8) or in the Overworld (in the Nether: times 8).
atlas.setting.layer.tooltip: Auto shows the cave layer at your height while you are under ground or under the Nether's roof, the surface otherwise. The world map's bar switches this too.
atlas.setting.biome_colors.tooltip: Grass, leaves and water in the colours their biome gives them. Off: a map item's fixed colours.
atlas.setting.radar_hostile.tooltip: Red dots on the maps for hostile mobs the game shows you nearby.
atlas.setting.radar_passive.tooltip: Green dots on the maps for animals, villagers and other mobs nearby.
atlas.setting.radar_players.tooltip: White dots on the maps for other players nearby; the world map names the one under the cursor.
atlas.setting.radar_items.tooltip: Small yellow dots on the maps for items lying nearby.
atlas.setting.spawn.tooltip: Keep a "Spawn" waypoint at the world spawn. Single player and LAN host only: a server does not tell.
atlas.setting.bed.tooltip: Keep a "Bed" waypoint at your respawn point (bed or respawn anchor).
atlas.setting.arrow.tooltip: An arrow at the top of the screen pointing to the tracked waypoint, with its distance. Pick the waypoint with Track in its bubble on the world map.
